scenarios.criterion: When a tick ends with no order running, no order claimable, and no order waiting on a human, and the supervisor was not already idle, it MUST print exactly 'idle — no ready orders; commit one to intake/ on <branch>', with the configured intake branch filled in.
scenarios.name: Supervisor reports idle when intake has never had a committed order
given: the intake branch is configured as "main"
intake/ has never had a committed order
the supervisor was not already idle
when: a tick ends with no order running, no order claimable, and no order waiting on a human
then: the supervisor prints exactly "idle — no ready orders; commit one to intake/ on main"

scenarios.criterion: When a tick ends with no order running, no order claimable, and no order waiting on a human, and the supervisor was not already idle, it MUST print exactly 'idle — no ready orders; commit one to intake/ on <branch>', with the configured intake branch filled in.
scenarios.name: Supervisor reports idle when every claimed order has shipped
given: every claimed order has reached the shipped phase
intake has no new ready candidate
the supervisor was not already idle
when: a tick ends with no order running, no order claimable, and no order waiting on a human
then: the supervisor prints exactly "idle — no ready orders; commit one to intake/ on main"

scenarios.criterion: When a tick ends with no order running and at least one order waiting on a human, it MUST print 'waiting on a human — <n> order(s) in the inbox: loom factory inbox', where n counts a gate halt, a commit proposal, a PR proposal, and a parked order.
scenarios.name: Supervisor reports one order waiting when a single order is halted at a gate
given: one order is halted at a gate awaiting human confirmation
no other order is running
when: a tick ends with no order running and at least one order waiting on a human
then: the supervisor prints exactly "waiting on a human — 1 order(s) in the inbox: loom factory inbox"

scenarios.criterion: When a tick ends with no order running and at least one order waiting on a human, it MUST print 'waiting on a human — <n> order(s) in the inbox: loom factory inbox', where n counts a gate halt, a commit proposal, a PR proposal, and a parked order.
scenarios.name: Supervisor counts a gate halt and a parked order together
given: one order is halted at a gate awaiting human confirmation
one additional order is parked
no other order is running
when: a tick ends with no order running and at least one order waiting on a human
then: the supervisor prints exactly "waiting on a human — 2 order(s) in the inbox: loom factory inbox"

scenarios.criterion: Given consecutive ticks remain in the same state, the line MUST print exactly once, on the tick that enters the state, and never again while the state persists unchanged.
scenarios.name: Idle line prints only on the tick that enters the idle state
given: the supervisor's previous tick entered the idle state and printed the idle line
when: a second consecutive tick ends in the same unchanged idle state
then: the idle line does not print again on the second tick

scenarios.criterion: Given consecutive ticks remain in the same state, the line MUST print exactly once, on the tick that enters the state, and never again while the state persists unchanged.
scenarios.name: Waiting line prints only on the tick that enters the waiting state
given: the supervisor's previous tick entered the waiting state with one order in the inbox and printed the waiting line
when: a second consecutive tick ends in the same unchanged waiting state with the same count
then: the waiting line does not print again on the second tick

scenarios.criterion: Given the supervisor leaves idle or waiting and later re-enters it, the line MUST print again; while waiting, a change in the waiting count MUST print the line again with the new count.
scenarios.name: Idle line prints again after the supervisor leaves and re-enters idle
given: the supervisor printed the idle line once
the supervisor then left idle by claiming and shipping an order
the supervisor later has no ready orders again
when: a tick ends in the idle state for a second time

scenarios.criterion: Given the supervisor leaves idle or waiting and later re-enters it, the line MUST print again; while waiting, a change in the waiting count MUST print the line again with the new count.
scenarios.name: Waiting line reprints with the new count when the waiting count changes
given: the supervisor is in the waiting state with one order in the inbox
the waiting line already printed once for count 1
when: a second order enters a waiting phase within the same waiting state
then: the supervisor prints the waiting line again with count 2

scenarios.criterion: Given loom factory run --once, the same once-per-entry rule MUST apply to its single tick, so the line prints at most once for that invocation.
scenarios.name: run --once prints the idle or waiting line at most once
given: the supervisor is invoked via "loom factory run --once"
when: the single tick ends in the idle or waiting state
then: the idle or waiting line prints at most once for that invocation

scenarios.criterion: The change MUST pass go test ./internal/factory/..., every new function MUST have cyclomatic complexity below 7, every changed line MUST be covered, and no file outside internal/factory/ MUST change except the run's own delivery record under docs/features/factory-idle-message/.
scenarios.name: The idle-message change meets the project's quality and boundary constraints
given: the idle-message feature is implemented in internal/factory/
then: every new function has cyclomatic complexity below 7
every changed or added line is covered by a test that can fail
no file outside internal/factory/ changed, other than the run's own delivery record under docs/features/factory-idle-message/
